meta.name: neopolis_abyssal_siege
meta.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

character.label: modern Hellenist coastal metropolis under abyssal siege

programs.brief: A gargantuan deep-sea leviathan rising out of the churning ocean bay, crowned head with glowing bioluminescent eyes, ribbed carapace plates, and giant writhing kraken tentacles crashing into the urban promenade.

A modern Hellenist titanium-and-quartz colossus of Athena Promachos overlooking the sea with an energized defense spear aimed at the bay, standing on a stepped neoclassical plinth with an entrance at base.
A hulking deep-sea monstrosity with carapace armor, bioluminescent maw, and clawed webbed talons breaching the quays.

tokens.event_direction: colossal sea monsters emerging from the coastal waters assaulting the waterfront promenade and urban harbor
tokens.infra: barricade_line along the seafront avenue and port perimeter; emergency cordon ringing the breached docks
tokens.icons: monumental modern colonnades and Hellenist civic buildings facing the sea; breached seawalls; towering leviathans rising from the bay amidst churning surf
